thread:
anya: Quick RFC follow-up — propose adding model-variant-aware penalties + tenant overrides so routing can prefer cheaper quantized variants but still respect tenant latency tiers. Thoughts? :thinking:

sam: quick q: do we need per-tenant model prefs or per-route? leaning per-tenant for simplicity.

kai: per-route gives more granularity (e.g., chat vs search) but explosion of rules. prefer per-tenant + route default.

jess: +1 for tenant-level. ops concerns: if cheap variant misbehaves, we need auto-fallback to higher-precision model.

maria: fallback should be automatic after N errors or latency > p99_thres. also need telemetry tag to link regressions to model variant.

anya: agree. sketch of policy fragment (pseudo):
```json
{
  "tenant_overrides": {
    "tenant:acme": {
      "prefer_variants": ["vicuna-q4_0", "vicuna-q8_0"],
      "latency_slo_ms": 200
    }
  },
  "fallback_policy": {
    "error_threshold": 10,
    "p99_latency_ms": 500,
    "fallback_to": ["vicuna-ggml", "redwood-alpha"]
  }
}
```

sam: can we make error_threshold based on absolute count or rate? prefer rate (errors / 1k requests).

kai: also need version-aware penalties: if model version v2 introduced, we shouldn't mix caches across variants. KV cache key needs model-id+variant.

jess: kv cache isolation is critical. otherwise caching QV output into FP model path is bad.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: policy-sandbox rollout at 2026-04-02T15:00Z. :calendar:

maria: also propose soft-penalty window for latency: gradually shift weight off cheap variant over 30s, not instant.

anya: UX: console should show per-tenant variant preferences + recent degrades and simulated cost delta.

sam: question: how do we reconcile dedicated vs hosted? tenant might have dedicated capacity where some variants are unavailable.

kai: runtime should respect placement: if preferred variant not in region/zone, fall back according to routing priorities.

jess: implementation note: policy-eval must be side-effect free; the runtime decides placement. policy only returns scores/penalties.

anya: next steps: draft small RFC with sections: DSL for variant prefs, telemetry hooks, cache key rules, rollout playbook. volunteers to co-author?

sam: i'll take DSL + tests.

kai: i'll own cache key + runtime handshake.

maria: i'll do telemetry + alerting pages.

jess: i'll write rollout checklist + ops runbook.

anya: thanks all. i'll open RFC tomorrow and ping the channel. :thumbsup:
